instruction_head:
# Build the first cut of `flowctl`

Stand up the `flowctl` CLI so a pipeline described in YAML actually runs end
to end: read a structured file, reshape each record through an ordered list
of stages, and write the surviving records to an output sink. The project
skeleton in `/app/` already has the module path, a README, and a couple of
smoke fixtures — everything else you add.

## Build & invocation

- The binary must be produced by `go build -o /app/flowctl ./cmd/flowctl` from
  inside `/app/`.

behavior_constraints: Accept input.format=sqlite; resolve input.path relative to the config file directory and require a non-empty input.query or abort with flowctl: config: ...
Execute the SQLite query exactly as written without rewriting it, and produce records whose column order matches the SELECT result-set column order.
Abort with a single stderr line starting flowctl: input: ... and non-zero exit if the SQLite file is missing/unreadable or the query execution fails.

Convert SQLite values to strings: TEXT as-is, INTEGER as decimal with no leading zeros/no thousands separators and leading - for negatives, REAL as integer-valued without trailing .0 otherwise Go %g, NULL as empty string, and BLOB as a hard flowctl: input: ... error.
Count SQLite result rows toward processed in the summary exactly like CSV/NDJSON records.

Validate group config: by is an ordered non-empty list; aggregates is non-empty; each aggregate has a required non-empty unique as, op in {count,sum,min,max,avg}, and column required for every op except count; invalid config aborts with flowctl: config: ...
For each input record, compute the group key from the values of the by columns in order; a record missing any by column aborts with flowctl: group: ...

For sum/min/max/avg, parse record[column] as a finite decimal number; a non-numeric value aborts with flowctl: group: non-numeric value in column <col> at row <n>, where n is the 1-based input-source record number.
Group is a full barrier: consume all incoming records before emitting any output rows; emit groups in first-seen order.
Emit exactly len(by)+len(aggregates) columns per group output record, ordered by[0], by[1], ..., aggregates[0].as, aggregates[1].as, ...; drop all other incoming columns.

Run pipeline record numbering, stage execution order, and summary counting must remain stable when a group barrier is inserted
InputConfig/StageConfig config parsing and validation must accept new sqlite/group fields without altering existing configs

instruction_head:
# Add a SQLite input source and a grouping stage

Grow `flowctl` so the pipeline can pull records out of a SQLite database and
collapse many input rows into aggregated summary rows. Keep every existing behavior exactly as it is; this change only adds
features. Nothing in the CLI invocation changes.

## New input format: `sqlite`

```yaml
input:
  path: orders.db
  format: sqlite
  query: "SELECT order_id, customer, amount, status FROM orders ORDER BY order_id"
```

- `path` is a path to a SQLite

behavior_constraints: kind must be 'inner' or 'left'; any other value is a config error prefixed 'flowctl: config: ...'
on must be a non-empty ordered list of column names present on both left and right records
right.input has the same shape as top-level input (path+format required, optional query for sqlite) and path resolves relative to the pipeline config file directory
right.select optional; when present projects each right record to exactly those columns in listed order, missing columns become ''
right.select omitted: right schema is the first right record's column order (CSV header order, NDJSON first-line key order, SQLite SELECT column order)
right.prefix default '' is prefixed to every non-on right column name added to the left record
Right side is loaded exactly once at the start of the join stage
Right-source I/O/parse/decode errors are emitted as a single stderr line starting with 'flowctl: input: ' and process exits non-zero
SQLite BLOB on the right side is a hard error with 'flowctl: input: ' prefix
Match is exact string equality of on-column values; no numeric coercion, trimming, or case folding

internal/pipeline/pipeline.go (per-input row numbering must survive join row expansion)

instruction_head:
# Add a `join` stage so pipelines can enrich records from a second source

Grow `flowctl` so that a pipeline can pull rows from a **second** data source
and splice fields from those rows onto the records flowing through the
pipeline. All existing behavior stays as-is; this change only adds a
new stage type called `join`.

## New stage: `join`

```yaml
- type: join
  kind: left            # or "inner"
  on: [customer]         # one or more columns
  right:
    input:
      path: customers.csv

behavior_constraints: A `dedup` stage type must be accepted by config loading and stage building.
`by` is a required non-empty list; empty or missing `by` is a config error prefixed `flowctl: config: dedup: ...`.
`keep` defaults to `first` and must be one of `first`, `last`, `min`, `max`, or `unique`; any other value is a config error.
`on` is required for `keep: min`/`max`, must be absent for `first`/`last`/`unique`, and is a single column name; violations are config errors.
`fallback` is only valid for `min`/`max`, defaults to `first`, must be `first` or `last`, and is a config error when provided for other keep modes or set to an invalid value.
Groups are formed by plain string equality on all `by` columns; empty-string values participate in grouping, but a missing `by` column is a hard runtime error prefixed `flowctl: dedup: `.
`keep: first` emits the first record per group in the order first records were seen; `keep: last` emits the last record per group in the relative ingest order of those last records.
`keep: unique` emits only records whose group has exactly one member, in original ingest order; groups with two or more members are dropped entirely.
For `keep: min`/`max`, survivors are emitted in the order of their ingest positions.
For `keep: min`/`max`, a missing or empty-string `on` value is a sentinel below all finite numbers; a present non-empty non-numeric `on` value is a hard runtime error prefixed `flowctl: dedup: `.

instruction_head:
# Add a `dedup` stage, and correct the missing-key behaviour of `sort`

Add a `dedup` stage, and fix the existing `sort` behavior for missing
numeric keys. All other behavior remains unchanged.

## Correction to `sort` — missing key columns no longer abort

### Previous behavior

The previous rule was: *"A missing key column in a record is treated
as the empty string for `string` comparisons, and as a hard error for
`number` comparisons."*

### New behavior

- `string`-typed key: unchanged — a m

behavior_constraints: A rank stage is recognized by config and stage.Build; invalid rank config produces stderr lines starting with flowctl: config: rank: and aborts.

partition_by defaults to empty; records group by exact string values of all partition_by columns; empty string does not suppress grouping; a participating record missing a partition_by column aborts with flowctl: rank: .

order_by is required and non-empty; each key requires column, as string|number, order asc|desc, and null_position first|last; bad null_position is config error flowctl: config: rank: null_position must be first or last.

For rank only, sentinel-equivalent values are placed first or last per null_position regardless of order; non-sentinel values compare by order; non-parseable present numeric values abort with flowctl: rank: .
method defaults to dense; dense has no gaps, rank skips ties, row gives distinct consecutive integers broken by ingest order, percent emits percent-rank strings.

percent computes rank-style integer ranks starting at 1, then p_i=(r_i-1)/max(1,n_part-1) formatted as exactly 6 decimal digits with banker's rounding, leading 0 in [0,1), no exponent, no plus, no trimming; single participating record yields 0.000000; start is rejected for percent.

into is required and must name a new column not already present on any participating input record; presence of the key aborts with flowctl: rank: even if empty; non-participating records pass through without into.
start defaults to 1, must be a non-negative integer literal, and sets the rank of the first distinct order_by tuple per partition.

skip_nulls defaults false; when true records whose entire order_by tuple is all-sentinel do not participate, are emitted unchanged at original ingest positions, do not affect counters/tie counts or into checks, and may lack partition_by columns without aborting.

reset_on optionally resets the rank counter within each partition's sorted order on value change; each run ranks independently from start; peer counts remain partition-wide; reset_on is rejected with percent, with into, with emit_peers, and when empty; missing reset_on values group as empty string.
affected_prior: StageConfig parsing in internal/config/config.go must accept the new rank stage
stage.Build dispatch in internal/stage/stage.go must route rank to buildRank
existing sort/dedup sentinel and group-key conventions are relied on by rank but must remain unchanged
entities.summary: Add a rank stage that assigns dense/rank/row/percent ranks within partition_by groups using ordered keys with null_position, skip_nulls, reset_on, bounds, and into-column semantics, without changing existing behavior.

instruction_head:
# Add a `rank` stage for per-group ordered row-numbering

Add a `rank` stage for ordered row-numbering within each group. All
existing behavior remains unchanged.

## New stage: `rank`

```yaml
- type: rank
  partition_by: [region, customer]   # optional; defaults to []
  order_by:                          # required, non-empty
    - column: amount
      as: number
      order: desc
      null_position: last            # required per key (first|last)
    - column: order_id
      as: string
